extraction: Public Drupal search-form AJAX responses. Each request uses only the sex secondary filter supported by the public form. Age breakdown is returned by the public age_salary chart.
limitations: Public period selector begins 2021Q1; 2019 and 2020 are unavailable in this application.
Youngest age group is <25 (form value 0-24), not exactly 15-24.
Salary is gross full-time-equivalent salary in this application; do not splice with gross monthly income.
Use the national series from the same application as comparison denominator; scope differs from other wage releases.
Do not use age_salary.series.custom.total as a wage: it is a sum of age-group wage levels.
The application displays wage comparisons using different sex denominators; calculate the conventional gap (male-female)/male explicitly.
The search UI allows one of county, age or sex filters at a time. This collection uses only sex; no hidden filter combination is requested.
